source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
During your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), you may bring back up to D3 of the bearer's unit's **destroyed** models, or up to 3 if that unit is in range of any [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) you control.

**CHARACTER** models in **Attached units** cannot come back this way. A **[[ONE SHOT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/one-shot)** weapon that a returned model fired before it was destroyed still counts as fired.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.oneShotState: retains prior firing state of each returned model
